- Description: QR code batch — 38 Kirsten chocolate-bar labels (generate, verify, deliver)
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):

  Details:
  Generated and delivered 38 serialized QR codes for Kirsten's loose-cacao-nib chocolate bars.
  
  BATCH IDENTIFIED
  Currency: "Agroverse 81% Cacao Chocolate Bar 50g | Oscar Cacao Nibs | Kirsten 20261027 | San Francisco - MAIN" (Currencies row 26, Serializable=TRUE, Oscar's Farm / Bahia / Brazil / Harvest 2024)

  3. Wrote the 38 rows via Sheets API per SOP section 5 (A1976:V2013, statuses MINTED).
  4. Rendered with batch_compiler.py driven natively from the sheet (fetch_rows) -- the sanctioned image path, never a bare qrcode.make().
  5. Verified: 38/38 decode --verify; 38/38 branding check (grayscale count > 10, a bare QR has exactly 2) -- the check that would have caught the 2026-10-20 396-unbranded-file incident; OCR reads farm/harvest/serial; 450x350 RGBA.
  6. Delivered zip to Discord #agroverse-qr-codes (msg 1572071039327019069), 2.2MB, 38 PNG + 38 manifests + README.
  
  EVIDENCE
  PR #39 merged 10292fd: 76 files added (38 PNG + 38 JSON), 0 modified, 0 deleted, serials exactly _3.._40, pre-existing _1/_2 byte-identical to main.
  
  FOLLOW-UPS SURFACED
  - dispatch.py silently swallows webhook failures -> any QR batch routed that way fails silently.
  - The orphaned [BATCH QR CODE REQUEST] event must not be replayed, or it would double-mint 76 serials for 38 physical bars.
  - 38 vs Kirsten's stated 39 still worth confirming; if 39 is right the gap is in offchain asset balance, not a missing code.
